<thought>We need to find retrosynthetic templates that break a carboxylic ester group, since the target contains a methyl ester. Using the correct functional group name "carboxylic esters" will allow the search to return templates that may use cheaper precursors such as a carboxylic acid and methanol. This could keep the total cost under $405.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
